summary: Comparison of single-shot Rube Goldberg machine animations generated across multiple models, highlighting Claude Opus 5.5 creating a 13-stage 3D workshop chain reaction ending with a rocket liftoff.

post.originalText:
Same prompt. Build a Rube Goldberg machine. One shot.

Opus 5.5: full 3D workshop, 13 stages, rocket liftoff finale. 21 min.
Grok 4.7: pretty 2D gold tracks. Needed the full 60 minutes.
Space Bunny: a labeled blueprint. Nice diagram, not a machine.
NVIDIA Nemotron: frozen until I fixed the null error. GPT-3 level in 2026.

There's Opus 5.5, and there's everyone else.

sourceMaterials.text: @broIMxd Spot on. It’s definitely more about spatial 'taste' than just raw code logic. Opus actually gets what a machine is.
sourceMaterials.author: mkeremturhan
